# Dewcue

> Dewcue is a calm, private reminder extension for Google Chrome (also runs in Chromium browsers such as Edge and Brave). Type reminders in plain words, get reply and follow-up reminders in Gmail, Outlook and Yahoo Mail, run Pomodoro, countdown and stopwatch timers with an on-page ribbon, and pin sticky notes to any web page. No account and no ads. Published by RATdeck Team; sold by Tanishkha (India).

Key facts (current version 1.0.6, October 2026):
- Install: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/llcaipjggcmogkkcpjmbgahhgkkfjojo
- Reminders in plain words ("call mom tomorrow at 6", "rent on the 5th", "vitamin D every morning"), repeating reminders, snooze, Today / Upcoming / Overdue lists.
- Quick choices when creating or rescheduling: Later today, Tomorrow 9 AM, Next week (next Monday 9 AM), plus a full date and time picker.
- Email: open an email in Gmail, Outlook on the web or Yahoo Mail and use "Remind me to reply" (Tomorrow 9 AM or custom date) or "Follow up" (In 3 days or custom date). Dewcue uses only the subject, sender name and link on screen; it never reads message bodies or asks for an email login.
- Timers: stopwatch, countdown and 25/5 Pomodoro; a slim ribbon shows the countdown on the page.
- Sticky notes: right-click "Add a sticky note here" or press Alt+Shift+K. Free includes 10 notes; Premium is unlimited. Alt+Shift+D opens Dewcue.
- Wellbeing nudges (water, eyes, posture, breaks) with quiet hours. English, Hindi and Tamil.
- Privacy: local-first; reminders sync through your own Chrome profile; sticky notes and buckets stay on the computer; backups and CSV export.
- Pricing: Free plan with clear limits. Premium $4.99/month or $39/year (14-day trial, no card). India: ₹199/month or ₹1,990/year plus 18% GST (₹234.82 and ₹2,348.20), UPI via Razorpay.
